mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_result SET is_correct = 1, attempted_at = SYSDATE WHERE qrNo = #{qrNo}
mapper.select: SELECT qr.*, CASE WHEN qw.quiz_no IS NOT NULL THEN qw.question ELSE NULL END AS question, qw.option1, qw.option2, qw.option3, qw.option4, qw.answer, qw.difficulty FROM quiz_result qr LEFT JOIN quiz_word qw ON qr.quizNo = qw.qwdno AND qr.quizType = 'WORD' LEFT JOIN quiz_proverb qp ON qr.quizNo = qp.qpvno AND qr.quizType = 'PROVERB' WHERE qr.userId = #{userId} AND qr.isCorrect = 0
